Which shortwave stations broadcast aimed at South America?

In the A-26 schedule, 45 stations broadcast aimed at South America. The most heavily scheduled include Rádio Nacional Amazônia, China Radio International, Radio Exterior España, HCJB Voice of Andes.

What frequencies are used for shortwave broadcasts aimed at South America?

The most-used frequencies are 17715, 6050, 6180, 11780, 4775 kHz. Which one is best depends on the time of day, the season and your location.

How can I listen without a shortwave radio?

Use a free WebSDR or KiwiSDR receiver in your browser. Our Listen Online page links to receivers and explains how to tune. Schedules are in UTC, so convert to your local time first.
